items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: we was coming with Bernie Young's band... Mike McKendrick... he and I came back on the bus... And we were having a ball on the bus. I had my horn, and I'm playing, and Mike, he had his banjo

ctx.x: If Mike had been there when --
If Mike had been there, Mike would have shot him, and we would have both been at Joliet, some place up there.
